title: FFRDC spun off from TRW as principal contractor for about 29 years

tellings.quote: only one and I won't name it um started out as a contractor in 1960s 30 not too long after it was born was actually spin-off of TRW

plain: One organisation is said to have been the main contractor for about 29 years, starting in the 1960s, on secret work studying recovered craft to learn how they work. It was a federally funded research and development center, a kind of nonprofit lab run for the government, that began as a spin-off of TRW, a large American aerospace and defense company. The physicist Eric W. Davis tells Michels this from what he was told, and says he won't name the organisation.
